factCheck.title: BPS FACT CHECK
factCheck.show: The JaP Newsroom · Policy Deployment Workshop 2026
factCheck.opening: Good morning, JaP. 2026 is done. Many things are being said about BPS GO!+. Today we check them, pillar by pillar, against the facts: what we achieved, and what we could not.
factCheck.signoff: Facts checked: most 2026 topics achieved, the gaps named, the 2030 vision ready. This was BPS Fact Check. Back to the studio.
ticker: JaP in TOP 5 plants of GB at the Mobility BPS Award 2026
Vision 2030 ready for NHA and VE value streams

claims.claim: BPS GO!+ in 2026 was only a slogan.

evidence.caption: 2026 key topics under the BPS GO!+ pillars · ✅ achieved · ⚠️ gap

claims.anchor: Six pillars, real results. Most topics were achieved, and we also name what we could not.
Routines, competency and training delivered. BLDP experts and SCIP completion are still open.

claims.claim: Not everybody takes part in improvement.
claims.anchor: Every associate involved, 28 ideas each. Improvement at JaP is everybody's job.

claims.claim: Our value streams did not get faster.
claims.source: Asked at the shop floor board

evidence.caption: Waste-Free, Stable Flow · throughput time reduction achieved

claims.anchor: VE from 17 to 14.01 days, NHA from 11.29 to 10.19 days. Flow is faster in both value streams.

claims.claim: CIP stops at the shop floor; indirect areas don't improve.

items.t: **100% indirect area coverage** through the **VSDiA** approach

claims.anchor: Every indirect area is covered by value stream design in indirect areas.

evidence.title: What we could not achieve in 2026

claims.anchor: A real fact check names the gaps. These five go straight into the 2027 plan.
60% of machines below 3% technical loss against a 90% target, and obsolescence half done. Top priority for 2027.

claims.claim: We don't know where BPS goes after 2026.

items.t: **House of BPS GO!+ 2027** with new targets per pillar

claims.anchor: Vision 2030 for both value streams, and the 2027 house as the next step towards it.

claims.claim: Digital is only talk at JaP.
claims.anchor: Four digital solutions live on the shop floor. Innovate, simplify, accelerate: in practice.

claims.claim: Our BPS maturity did not move.

points: 2026 assessed with the **new version 4.26**, a stricter standard
evidence.caption: BPS assessment 2026

claims.anchor: From 1.96 to Level 2.4, and on the new, stricter version 4.26.

claims.claim: Nobody outside JaP notices our BPS work.

evidence.caption: Mobility BPS Award 2026 · applied in 2 categories · TOP 5 plants in GB

claims.anchor: Two categories, and JaP among the top 5 plants in GB.

audit.claim: BPS is claiming they have completed and achieved 85% of their tasks in 2026.
audit.check: Let's check it against the BPS GO!+ Roadmap 2026, row by row.
